name: Colossal Channeler
reason: Rage-gated reach +10 ft, optional Large/Huge size, 2d4 thunder on melee/thrown attacks and a 5 ft (15 ft on crit) damage spread with DC 8+Str+prof cannot be one passive effect.
proposal: Note-only utility activity describing the rage benefits; optionally rage-gated bonus '+2d4[thunder]' on system.bonuses.mwak.damage/rwak.damage. Spread stays manual.

name: Conqueror's Haki Journeyman
reason: Doubles Overwhelming Presence range, adds 3/long-rest Domination on humanoids, +prof to the Crushing Will check and upgrades Subjugate Foe (120 ft, 2d6 force) by modifying other abilities.
proposal: Optionally a utility activity 'Domination (humanoid)' with uses max 3 recover lr; upgrades to other features belong in those features' specs.

name: Constant Shots
reason: Regains two uses of Advanced Arsenal when initiative is rolled with no uses left; needs an initiative trigger and a link to another feature's uses.
proposal: MANUAL, or Midi/macro hook on initiative that adds 2 uses to Advanced Arsenal if value is 0.

name: Corrosive Soul
reason: Unconditional resistance to acid damage (the two tricks are spell grants).
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'acid'}]

name: Crazed Bravado
reason: Unconditional fire and thunder resistance and deafened immunity; the rage-only reload interaction is narrative.
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'fire'},{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'thunder'},{key:'system.traits.ci.value',mode:2,value:'deafened'}]

name: Creative Ambush
reason: Disadvantage on the target's saves against your creation this turn only if you were hidden; depends on stealth state and the creation used.
proposal: MANUAL, or note-only utility activity as a reminder.

name: Crusher
reason: +1 Str or Con is a choice; the once-per-turn 5 ft push on a bludgeoning hit and crit-triggered advantage until start of next turn are hit riders.
proposal: MANUAL (ASI via advancement); optional note-only activity for the push and crit rider.

name: Cut Time
reason: Walk speed +10 ft is unconditional, but attacking twice on the Attack action (and when readying) is not a plain effect.
proposal: Partial: changes [{key:'system.attributes.movement.walk',mode:2,value:'10'}]; extra attack stays text.

name: Dark Wing Hunter
reason: Blindsight 10 ft (lost if deafened) and fly speed equal to walk speed (lost in heavy armor) have conditions; the ASI is a choice. Batch 2 already left it as text.
proposal: Optional: changes [{key:'system.attributes.senses.blindsight',mode:4,value:'10'},{key:'system.attributes.movement.fly',mode:4,value:'@attributes.movement.walk'}] with a note on deafened/heavy armor; MANUAL is safer.

name: Dragon Claw
reason: Unarmed die up one size matches the existing flags.op5e.unarmedDieStep mechanism, but double damage to objects and structures is GM-adjudicated.
proposal: effects: [{name:'Dragon Claw',transfer:true,changes:[{key:'flags.op5e.unarmedDieStep',mode:2,value:'1'}]}]; object damage stays text.

name: Dragon Talons
reason: Changes Dragon Grip's extra damage to 1d6 and upcasts Thunderwave in Dragon's Breath to 2nd level; both modify other features.
proposal: Edit the Dragon Grip and Dragon's Breath specs (level scaling) instead of this feat.

name: Drunken Arts
reason: Temp HP equal to Wisdom modifier at the start of each turn (doubled at 6th level) with at least 1 HP needs a usable turn-start heal.
proposal: { activities:[{type:'heal', name:'Drunken Arts Temp HP', activation:'special', healing:{custom:true, formula:'@abilities.wis.mod * (@details.level >= 6 ? 2 : 1)', types:['temp']}}] }

name: Eagle Eyes
reason: Mile-long vision, never disadvantage on ranged attacks, advantage on Perception while not incapacitated, and doubled ranged weapon range mix narrative and rider mechanics.
proposal: Partial Midi-only: flags.midi-qol.advantage.skill.prc with incapacitated condition; range doubling via item edits; otherwise MANUAL.

name: Echoing Soul
reason: Unconditional resistance to thunder damage (tricks are spell grants).
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'thunder'}]

name: Elemental Adept
reason: Chosen damage type and ASI are player choices; ignoring resistance and treating 1s as 2s depend on that choice.
proposal: Leave as text; no dnd5e key for per-type resistance ignore.

name: Endless Vigor
reason: Adds Con mod to Second Wind healing (another item) and raises HP max by 'twice your level, and by 2 every level thereafter', which is ambiguous.
proposal: Ambiguous; if read as +2*level: changes [{key:'system.attributes.hp.bonuses.overall',mode:2,value:'+2*@details.level'}]; Second Wind rider stays text. Recommend MANUAL pending DM wording.

name: Enhanced Circuitry
reason: Lightning resistance is already shipped by the batch 2 effect; the Countershock grant is a creation, not something this item must express.

name: Enhanced Evolution
reason: Resistance depends on the damage type chosen for Spark of War; Absorption gets uses equal to proficiency bonus per long rest.
proposal: Optional utility activity 'Absorption' with uses {max:'@prof', recovery:[{period:'lr',type:'recoverAll'}]}; resistance stays manual.

name: Enhanced Forms
reason: d10 damage die, disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you, and bludgeoning/piercing/slashing resistance all depend on the Experimental Medicine form chosen.
proposal: MANUAL; if the form is fixed, add dr.value mode 2 for bludgeoning, piercing, slashing.

name: Enhanced Formula
reason: Modifies the summoned Experimental Ooze (Large, 4d4+prof / 2d8+prof, per-ooze-type riders incl. Con save and 2d4 fire ignite) depending on the chosen ooze type.
proposal: Handle in the Experimental Ooze summon spec as a level-gated variant; leave this feat as text.

name: Eyes Open
reason: Initiative and Passive Perception bonuses equal to proficiency bonus plus Expertise in Deception and Insight are unconditional; the ASI is a choice.
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.attributes.init.bonus',mode:2,value:'+@prof'},{key:'system.skills.prc.bonuses.passive',mode:2,value:'+@prof'},{key:'system.skills.dec.value',mode:4,value:'2'},{key:'system.skills.ins.value',mode:4,value:'2'}] (expertise only if already proficient is not guaranteed; verify)

name: Fear Factor
reason: Advantage on Intimidation only against creatures at least one size smaller; depends on target size.
proposal: MANUAL; leave as text.

name: Fearsome Fortitude
reason: One chosen saving throw proficiency, plus HP max increase of one hit die roll + Con mod and an extra hit die are choice/roll driven.
proposal: Leave as text; one-time manual adjustment.

name: Ferocious Charger
reason: On a hit after moving 10 ft straight, target makes a Strength save (DC 8 + prof + Str mod) or is knocked prone, once per turn; mounted adds extra damage equal to level.
proposal: { activities:[{type:'save', name:'Ferocious Charge', activation:'special', save:{ability:['str'], dc:{calculation:'', formula:'8 + @prof + @abilities.str.mod'}}, effects:[{status:'prone',onSave:false}]}] }; once-per-turn and mounted bonus stay text

name: Fiery Soul
reason: Unconditional fire damage resistance (temperature tolerance is narrative; tricks are spell grants).
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'fire'}]

name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
reason: +2 damage only on ranged hits with a thrown weapon; a plain rwak bonus would also hit non-thrown ranged weapons, and drawing as part of the attack is narrative.
proposal: MANUAL, or Midi-only rwak damage +2 gated on the thrown property. Do not apply an unconditional bonus. Same text on 4 duplicate docs.

name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
reason: +2 damage only on ranged hits with a thrown weapon; a plain rwak bonus would also hit non-thrown ranged weapons, and drawing as part of the attack is narrative.
proposal: MANUAL, or Midi-only rwak damage +2 gated on the thrown property. Do not apply an unconditional bonus. Same text on 4 duplicate docs.

name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
reason: +2 damage only on ranged hits with a thrown weapon; a plain rwak bonus would also hit non-thrown ranged weapons, and drawing as part of the attack is narrative.
proposal: MANUAL, or Midi-only rwak damage +2 gated on the thrown property. Do not apply an unconditional bonus. Same text on 4 duplicate docs.

name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
reason: +2 damage only on ranged hits with a thrown weapon; a plain rwak bonus would also hit non-thrown ranged weapons, and drawing as part of the attack is narrative.
proposal: MANUAL, or Midi-only rwak damage +2 gated on the thrown property. Do not apply an unconditional bonus. Same text on 4 duplicate docs.

name: Fists of Fury
reason: Unarmed die d6 (d8 with no weapon or shield) is a die choice, and the rage-gated disadvantage on the target's attacks against others lasts until your next turn.
proposal: Partial: flags.op5e.unarmedDieStep if consistent with unarmed.ts; rider stays text/note-only activity.

name: Fortified Position
reason: +2 AC and Dex saves for you and allies within 10 ft of the cannon is an aura tied to the cannon token; two cannons is table-dependent.
proposal: MANUAL, or an aura effect on the cannon actor with system.attributes.ac.bonus +2 and system.abilities.dex.bonuses.save +2.

name: Free Diver
reason: Swim speed equal to walk speed or +10 ft if you already have a swim speed branches on existing speed; breath hold is narrative; Con +1 is fixed ASI.
proposal: Optional mode 4 swim = walk like Buck-Toothed, but the +10 branch is inexpressible; batch 2 left it as text.

name: Friend of the Sea
reason: Speaking with swimming creatures is narrative and the Animal Handling advantage applies only to marine creatures.
proposal: Leave as text.

name: Frozen Soul
reason: Unconditional cold damage resistance (temperature tolerance is narrative; tricks are spell grants).
proposal: changes: [{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'cold'}]

name: Gigantic Might
reason: Rage-gated +5 ft reach, size to Large, +1d4 thunder on melee/thrown attacks and a crit shockwave dealing thunder damage equal to level within 5 ft.
proposal: Optional rage-gated effect on the Rage activity: size 'lg' plus mwak/rwak damage '+1d4[thunder]'; shockwave stays text/note.

name: Grappler
reason: Advantage on attacks against a creature you are grappling and bonus-action grapple depend on grapple state; Str +1 is an ASI.
proposal: MANUAL, or a utility activity with bonus activation for the grapple; Midi advantage flag keyed to grappled target.

name: Gullible
reason: Disadvantage on Insight only when detecting lies; a flat disadvantage on all Insight would overreach.
proposal: MANUAL.

name: Gunner
reason: Firearms proficiency, ignoring reload/loading and no disadvantage for adjacent hostiles on ranged attacks are weapon-specific riders; Dex +1 is an ASI.
proposal: Optional weapon proficiency via system.traits.weaponProf.value mode 2 'fir' if the key exists; riders stay text.
